bullets.text: AI Breakthrough Funding - **DeepMind**'s David Silver raises $1.1B for a new AI venture focused on learning without human data.
Nothing's File-Sharing Comeback - **Nothing** revives its Android-to-computer file-sharing tool, Warp, after initial withdrawal.
Giannandrea Joins CuspAI - Former **Apple** AI chief John Giannandrea takes an advisory role at UK startup **CuspAI**.
Samsung Wallet's Travel Feature - New **Samsung Wallet** feature organizes travel plans into a detailed itinerary.
Google Wallet Expands ID Support - **Google Wallet** adds support for digital passport IDs from Brazil, Singapore, and Taiwan.
Apple Wallet's Digital ID Update - **Apple Wallet** enhances its Digital ID feature for age verification and more.
Social Media Scam Surge - Consumers lost $2.1 billion to social media scams in 2025, with **Facebook** being the most reported platform.
AI Features Coming to Ubuntu - **Canonical** plans to integrate AI features into **Ubuntu** throughout 2026.
Investors Back AI Home Screen App - **Skye**, an AI app for iPhone, garners significant investor interest ahead of launch.
OpenAI Resolves Legal Issues - **OpenAI** renegotiates its deal with **Microsoft**, easing concerns over its $50 billion Amazon deal.
